Things that instantly make
a man look older

1. Slouching

Shoulders back.
It takes ten years off.

2. Clothes that don't fit

Too big reads as tired.

3. Complaining about everything

Negativity ages faster
than any wrinkle.

4. Never trying anything new

Same food, same music,
same opinions.

5. A mind that stopped learning

Curious men stay young.
Learn a little every day.
